name: pattern-vs-component
title: Format template vs library component
summary: The same key/value spec row built twice: four SpecRow calls of a definePattern template that the player inflates, and four calls of the KeyValueRow library component that json2rc expands into plain components before writing. They look the same; the template costs about 48 B per extra row, the expanded component about 200 B (KeyValueRow v3, whose key ellipsizes in a weighted box).
prompt: A phone spec card (Display 6.1 in OLED, Chip A18, Storage 256 GB, Battery 3,561 mAh) built once with a definePattern row template and once with the KeyValueRow library component, to compare them.
teaches: Choose definePattern when the same row repeats: the body is stored once in the .rc and each call is a pattern inflation with its argument ids (measured here: 840 B for 1 row, 1078 B for 6, about 48 B per extra row)

Choose a library component (KeyValueRow) for richer options (slots, $if, theme tokens) resolved at conversion: json2rc expands each call into plain components, so every call costs its full body (788 B for 1 row, 1641 B for 6, about 171 B per row)
Re-theme library components by defining their colours (surface, muted, onSurface) in resources.colors; a template reads the same named colours through @colors
pitfalls: A text inside a template measures as one component for every instance (U7): two intrinsic-width texts in a row collide, clipped to one instance's width. Give template texts a weight or fixed width (here both texts take weight 1, the value right-aligned)
The break-even is about two rows: with one call the template's definition (about 52 B) is pure overhead
The Java parser only sees the expanded document: a library component call is a json2rc feature, and doc.expanded.json is what is byte-checked; definePattern is in the format and every parser reads it

snippets.note: SpecRow template: key and value, both texts weighted
the library call: {"KeyValueRow": {key, value}}, expanded at conversion

check.describe: Two cards with the same four rows, keys muted on the left and values right-aligned; the top card's label says definePattern, the bottom one KeyValueRow. Resized (narrow 240, wide 540) both cards fill the width, keys stay left and values right in both builds, and a caption too long for the card ellipsizes.
